summary_note_en: Rule events log when a strategy rule was observed, triggered, ignored, or completed. This is the trigger history, not the execution ledger.

entry_template.note_en: Describe what rule fired and why.

rule_type_reference.drawdown_add: NAV fell from peak enough to trigger extra capital deployment.
rule_type_reference.rebalance_band_breach: Allocation drift exceeded the configured band.
rule_type_reference.monthly_contribution_target: Rule selected a target sleeve for the next contribution.
rule_type_reference.manual_override: User intentionally overrode the default rule.

status_reference.observed: Condition detected but no action decided yet.
status_reference.executed: Action completed and linked to a log entry.
